ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.

2. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading: Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading: Fluency.

   A. Avoid speaking to classmates

----
